conclusion: The small checked compiler facade is an outlier against the CakeML facade because compact Input/Agrees contracts hide detail that the reference facade exposes; both sides delegate. Other measured facade and finite-case ratios are within 3x. Additional similar-theorem ratios include small fixed local computations and delegating calculus facades versus general external theorems. Their recorded outliers reflect different generality or proof packaging, not measured transitive proof effort. Semantic compiler weaknesses are assessed from permitted behaviours, not inferred from these sizes.
